Proposition
[Outer profile (36.33)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0344 ↗ def:chow-iv-parabolic-leading-mode ↗ def:chow-iv-intermediate-profile 1. ch36:36.33\group Matched Asymptotics

In an outer region where $\sigma =e^{\tau /2}s\to -\infty $, matching with the parabolic region gives \[ \psi (s,t)^2\approx 2(n-1)\left[(T-t)-(s/c)^2\right]. \] If $k$ is even, the full diameter decays on the scale $|s|\le c(T-t)^{1/(2k)}$; if $k$ is odd, the distance from the equator to the right pole has this scale.
